# App UI

App UI consumes `@asym/ui`. Do not define an app-local visual system or fork shared primitives. Follow `packages/ui/AGENTS.md` and preserve exact `base-maia`. Load `docs/ai/skills/moai-library-shadcn/SKILL.md` for registry or generated-component work.

For UI lint and shared-contract changes, use the canonical workflow in
`docs/ai/skills/moai-library-shadcn/references/design-system-lint.md`.
